name: AetherBuilder
changelog: New: Instant Page Loading (Splash Screen & Pre-loader 100% Optional) - when disabled, the entire black screen, spinner overlay, and initialization delay are completely bypassed for blazing fast immediate page rendering
New: Disable Initializing Sub-caption - unchecking 'Show' on Sub-caption immediately eliminates 'Initializing modules & layout engine' text and its timing across both live pages and the editor
UX: Clear 'Enable Splash Screen' toggle and Instant Loading status banner in Site Settings (⚙️ Site Tab) with live preview updates
Performance: Synchronous pre-paint CSS injection in <head> ensuring zero black flash or spinner rendering when splash screen is disabled
Performance: Reduced loader dismissal and failsafe auto-dismiss timing so pages never wait unnecessarily
Media Library: 1-click '✏️ Rename' button on media cards to rename any image, JSON template, or upload directly on disk without re-uploading
Site Settings: Template Autosave & Backup Settings with auto-rotation limit (1, 3, 5, 10, 20, 50) and live prune cleanup
Forms: Registration Form Image Options with Fit / Natural (Max Image Priority), Banner (3:1), and expanded Landscape (16:9)
